title: Gao Lut House Featured in the Press
description: Gao Lut House by MVN Group has been recognized at Awards Cycle 52 for its outstanding architectural value, highlighting the harmony between contemporary design, functionality, local identity, and sustainable living principles.
author: MVN Group
content:
MVN Group is proud to have our project recognized at Awards Cycle 52 — one of the prestigious platforms honoring architectural and design works with outstanding creative value.

The project was highly appreciated for its harmonious combination of contemporary aesthetics, optimized functionality, and a strong sense of local identity expressed through every detail. This recognition is not only an acknowledgment of a specific project but also a testament to our commitment to sustainable development and a thoughtful design philosophy that we continuously pursue.

The award serves as a motivation for us to continue exploring, innovating, and creating meaningful living spaces — where people, natural light, and materials are thoughtfully connected to create lasting architectural values.
